meta.provenance: every value is COPIED from an audited artifact named in each row's `source`; nothing is recomputed from raw dumps here
meta.scope: doc 2.1 K_eval generalisation (no retraining) + 2.2 K_train sensitivity + 2.3 outsider bound B sensitivity. No full K x B cartesian grid (doc 4).
meta.B_sweep_control: Every B cell fixes PAIR_NEGS=10, i.e. the number of sampled negatives per user is held constant so a B sweep varies the candidate RANGE only, not the pair count / total loss strength (doc 2.3). The 3-seed main result (arm `hserve_pair`) uses ALL negatives and is therefore NOT comparable inside the sweep -- `pb40` is its in-sweep counterpart.
meta.B_sweep_on_DA_note: The B sweep is run on the main method (HServe+plain pair), not on DA-CDRS: `da_cdrs_loss` has no fixed-negative-count knob, so a B sweep there would change the candidate range AND the loss strength together -- exactly the confound doc 2.3 forbids. The K_train sweep IS additionally run on the DA method (family `K_train_DA`), where no such control is required.
meta.intruder_cdf_pointer: The student-Top-10 intruder teacher-rank CDF that justifies B=40 lives in kb_intruder_cdf.{json,csv} (width-50 deployment ladder, canonical) and kb_intruder_cdf_w64.{json,csv} (width-64 ladder, matched to the M=64 teacher TRAINING dump that B actually indexes). Read each file's `limitation` first: the two ladders are NOT interchangeable.

collab_export.numbers_changed: none -- values are copied verbatim from our internal package
collab_export.labels: `method` is the delivery doc's own name for the arm; `arm_id` keeps our internal label so a cell can still be referred to unambiguously. In the run_manifest files there is no `method` arm column at all: the original `method` there names the INFERENCE SCRIPT FAMILY (sidmlp / nezha / gdn / …), so it is passed through as `decode_family`, and the arm identity is carried by `tag` -> `arm_id` / `doc_name` instead.
collab_export.paths: absolute cluster paths reduced to project-relative; checkpoint / sem_ids / teacher_cache / pop_cache fields reduced to basename
collab_export.kept_in_full: command, config, seed, hyper-parameters, commit, teacher-cache identity, sample counts, CIs (doc §5.8)
